narrative:
## Handover Summary — GP Target Setting

Targets are locked at group, product family and market level, cascaded proportionally from the AI forecast.

## Key Decisions
• Conversational Channels stretched to reflect WhatsApp per-message pricing and RCS launch
• Verification & Security raised on PSD3 OTP demand and 70%-margin SMS Firewall contracts
• Carrier Wholesale held flat — volume for routing scale, not margin

## Recommendation for Traffic & Volume Forecast
Convert GP targets into message volumes per product and market. Test whether Norway campaign SMS cannibalisation by RCS/WhatsApp is already visible in Q4 traffic.

## Risk Factors
• Operator termination increases (5-7%) not yet passed through
• GP ambition gap of ~NOK 30M remains open until pricing and routing phases

signals.title: MyLINK CORE — Group Strategy Update
signals.excerpt: Group ambition: double-digit gross profit growth driven by conversational channels, verification and platform revenue on a consolidated MyLINK CORE stack.

signals.title: Nordic operators announce A2P termination increases
signals.excerpt: Telenor, Telia and Telia Finland notify 5-7% A2P SMS termination increases effective 1 January 2026.
